- The team decides to use regular batteries as the energy source (A). [TS3012c: "Yeah. Okay, anyway. Uh energy, we choose regular regular batteries. The"]

- The team decides to consider an LCD screen to satisfy the target group (A,B,C,D). [TS3012c: "let's say because it is uh very hot in n our target group"]
- The team decides to use rubber as the material (A,B,C,D). [TS3012c: "Then rubber would be the best as a material"]
